messages:
tess: Heads-up: saw a customer ticket where a streaming session that triggered a toolcall resulted in both a provisional and a confirmed charge after a reconnect. trace: zc-5d7

ben: quick q: provisional + confirmed (replace) or provisional left and confirmed added (double-charge)?

tess: double-charge (both present). timeline: router accepted -> provisional estimate 96 tokens; mid-stream reconnect -> route to fallback (headers-sanitized), runtime retried toolcall (no idempotency header) -> confirmed 78 tokens; billing shows both entries. snippet:
```
[zc-5d7] router: accept provisional=96 model=redwood-mu
[zc-5d7] router: route-change -> pod-b (sanitize-headers=true)
[zc-5d7] runtime: toolcall replayed (idempotency=null) tokens=78
[zc-5d7] billing: ledger write provisional +96
[zc-5d7] billing: ledger write confirmed +78
```

alyssa: looks like two issues: header preservation during route-swap + billing upsert/dedupe semantics. billing currently dedupes on runtime_request_id only, which doesn't help when header lost.

ryan: proposal: router should mint X-Session-Commit-ID at ingress and pass it downstream. billing writes provisional with that commit id; runtime writes confirmed referencing same id. billing upsert on session_commit_id -> replace pending with final. If header missing, runtime can synthesize but billing tags it runtime-scoped.

ben: agree. console change: show a "pending tokens" column and mark them as tentative. add tooltip: "pending estimate — may be adjusted on finalization". add an admin filter to surface large pending items.

billing-bot: note: changes required: ledger needs pending bucket (pending_balance) separate from invoiced_balance; migrations for prior provisional entries; new events: billing.pending.created, billing.pending.finalized, billing.pending.expired.

alyssa: short-term mitigation: revert the header-sanitization rule in canary and add a runtime guard to reject toolcall replay if idempotency header absent and no session-commit-id present (fail fast).

ryan: telemetry: emit session_commit_id in traces from router and runtime. events: router.session.start(session_commit_id, estimate, model_hint), billing.pending.created(session_commit_id), billing.finalized(session_commit_id, final_tokens).

tess: owners: router#411 preserve-session-header (@ryan), billing#801 pending-ledger (@alyssa), console#55 pending-ui (@ben), telemetry#314 session-commit-events (@ryan). QA: add e2e scenarios for route-swap w/ header preserved, route-swap w/out header, model fallback lower tokens, truncated stream EOF.

ben: I'll prototype the dashboard tile: "pending vs finalized delta" and alert if delta > 5% for orgs with >1000 tokens/minute.

tess: thanks — I'll file the incident ticket and draft the billing design doc. ping when PRs exist. :thumbsup:
